4:29.arabic: وَلَا تَقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُمۡ رَحِيمٗا
4:29.translation: And do not kill yourselves [or one another]. Indeed, Allah is to you ever Merciful.

4:82.arabic: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَۚ وَلَوۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ غَيۡرِ ٱللَّهِ لَوَجَدُواْ فِيهِ ٱخۡتِلَٰفٗا كَثِيرٗا
4:82.translation: Will they not then ponder on the Qur'an? If it had been from other than Allah they would have found therein much incongruity.
4:82.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930)

61:2.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
61:2.translation: O believers! Why do you say what you do not do?
61:2.translator: Dr. Mustafa Khattab, The Clear Quran

61:3.arabic: كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُواْ مَا لَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
61:3.translation: How despicable it is in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do!
61:3.translator: Dr. Mustafa Khattab, The Clear Quran
